build_docker_image: build a Docker image from a directory using the Docker buildx command or Python client
create_tag: create a timestamp-based Docker image tag in YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-ffffff format
prepare_directory: prepare a staging directory by copying source files, Dockerfile, and entrypoint into a destination folder
push_docker_image: push a Docker image to a registry and verify it is accessible, also pushing the latest tag
test_docker_installed: test whether Docker is installed and accessible on the local machine
